name: Normal
description: Predictable, mostly stable Void pressure with occasional surges that permanently worsen the baseline a little.

announcements.title: 🌑 MASS AT THE BARRIER
announcements.text: The darkness beyond Aethelgard is moving. Hundreds of shapes gather outside the Barrier and throw themselves against the light in relentless waves. The shield holds. For now.

announcements.title: ⛈️ VOIDSTORM
announcements.text: The sky turns black. Lightning crawls across the Barrier without thunder, leaving violet scars hanging in the air. Beyond the city, the Void churns like a stormfront, and something enormous moves inside it.

announcements.title: 🌧️ BLACK RAIN
announcements.text: Rain begins falling across Aethelgard, but never reaches the ground. Every droplet becomes black mist and rises toward the Barrier as the entire shield starts to hum under mounting pressure.

announcements.title: 🔇 THE SILENT SURGE
announcements.text: For several minutes the Void becomes completely still. No creatures. No wind. No movement. Then the entire Barrier bends inward at once and a deep vibration rolls through every building in Aethelgard.
